caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher centered on a plain, pale beige background. The pitcher is predominantly terracotta in color, with a glossy surface creating subtle light reflections, particularly near the rim and body. A horizontal band in a darker, uneven brown runs around the midsection of the pitcher, suggesting a glazed design. The vessel has a curved, bulbous body, a slightly flared spout, and a rounded handle on the right side. In the bottom left corner, there is a small, simple line sketch of the pitcher accompanied by some measurement marks. The artist's name, “GORDON SALTER,” along with the code “DEL 156-1,” is written in small capital letters along the lower right edge of the image.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
